item.title: New way to get rid of food waste coming to Oahu
item.description: Oahu residents will soon be able to dispose of food waste in their green bins as part of a pilot program to reduce the amount of food waste going into landfills and create nutrient-rich fertilizer for local farmers and homeowners.
